description: 2026 is the Year of the Fire Horse in the Chinese zodiac, from February 17, 2026 to February 5, 2027. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2026 is the Year of the Fire Horse, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 17, 2026 and ended on February 5, 2027, so people born in 2026 before Feb 17 belong to the Wood Snake year.

sections.heading: 2026 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Fire Horse year on February 17, 2026, and the year ran to February 5, 2027. So a birth date of Feb 17, 2026 or later counts as Fire Horse, and so do early 2027 birthdays through Feb 5; births in 2026 before Feb 17 still belong to the Wood Snake. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1966 are Fire Horse years too. That Tuesday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Fire Horse is like
paragraphs: Double Fire gives this Horse year a reputation for blazing vitality. Those born now are pictured as charismatic, outspoken and eager for experience, inspiring company for anyone who can keep up. Readings frame that intensity as a strength needing direction: consulting a trusted friend before big leaps and choosing commitments that allow independence. Their enthusiasm can be infectious, drawing friends into adventures they would never have tried alone.

Belonging to the south and to the height of summer, Fire brings brightness, drive and visibility to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with enthusiasm, leadership and the urge to be seen and to make an impression. A Fire stem tends to make an animal more expressive, more daring and more openly emotional than its usual reputation suggests. People born in Fire years are often described as inspiring company and natural motivators. The caution most readings attach is a short fuse and a difficulty with slow seasons, when steady effort matters more than spark and the reward is a long way off.

sections.heading: 2026 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits reduce to 1, the number of beginnings, initiative and independence, so numerologists describe a 1 year as one that rewards starting things. The digits of 2026 add up to 10, which reduces to 1. The Horse holds the seventh place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Fire. Set beside the year's Fire stem, fire year element matches the fixed element, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Wood Snake and the year after is the Fire Goat.

Chinese almanacs name 2026 Bing-Wu, pairing the Fire stem Bing with the branch Wu. Both are Yang, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2026?
faq.answer: 2026 is the Year of the Fire Horse. It started on February 17, 2026 and ended on February 5, 2027.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2026?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 17. Born before February 17, 2026, you are a Wood Snake; born on or after it, you are a Fire Horse.

faq.question: What element is 2026 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Fire, a Yang year. The Horse's own fixed element is Fire; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2026?
faq.answer: Bing-Wu. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Fire Horse year?
faq.answer: 2086, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1966.
